svg.title: Most Used Languages
svg.desc: Most used languages across public non-fork repositories, each repository weighted equally: Python 26.8%, HTML 12.2%, JavaScript 9.2%, C 8.2%, Rust 7.0%, Dart 6.8%, C++ 6.4%, TypeScript 4.7%, Java 4.3%, Other 14.3%.
